_status: PROPOSED — NOT DEPLOYED. Live pipeline 9c7b26bd-11f3-432f-a7df-a30b56a8955f is unchanged.
_how_to_deploy: The SecOps Pipelines UI takes ONE BARE REGEX per exclude processor and generates the OTTL wrapper itself. Paste the '_ui_regex' value of each processor - NOT the logConditions value. See DEPLOY_AZURE_SQL.md.
_ui_model: One regex per processor. Multiple processors combine as OR (each drops independently). You CANNOT AND two conditions inside one processor, and RE2 has no lookahead - so every rule below is a single self-contained regex.
_design: ZERO-EVIDENTIARY-COST filter set. Every rule targets telemetry carrying no security evidence, so nothing here weakens exfiltration, insider-threat, authentication or permission-change detection. SQLSecurityAuditEvents is left intact apart from paired-marker noise.
_why_deployable_now: No rule drops evidence, so this set does NOT depend on verifying Azure-side audit retention (assessment point 5). It can proceed while the routine-DML question (point 1) is resolved at governance level.
_excluded_deliberately: No routine-DML drop (proposed D3) and no successful-authentication drop (proposed D4). D3 additionally CANNOT be implemented safely in this UI - see _d3_not_implementable.
_d3_not_implementable: Dropping routine DML safely requires ANDing three conditions (action_name AND statement matches DML AND succeeded=true) so that FAILED statements are preserved. The one-regex-per-processor model plus RE2's lack of lookahead makes that guard impossible to express. A single-regex DML drop would remove FAILED SELECTs too - destroying probing/injection/permission-denial visibility. This is an additional, independent reason not to pursue D3 here.
_governance: Decision Paper: Filtering of AZURE_SQL, 20/08/2026. FILTER HEAVILY, P2. NOTE: this set alone will NOT reach the 80% target - see AZURE_SQL_FILTER_DESIGN.md.
description: Azure SQL Log - zero-evidentiary-cost volume reduction (governance decision 20/08/2026)

processors._rule: R1 — non-security diagnostic / performance / health categories
processors._change: REPLACE the existing processor 1 regex. Strict superset of the live 6 categories: 5 added, 0 removed.
processors._cost: Zero. None of these categories carry authentication, permission, configuration or data-access evidence.
processors._note: 'Errors' deliberately NOT included - it can carry investigation value (failed statements, injection attempts). Decision pending.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"category\":\\s*\"(DatabaseWaitStatistics|QueryStoreWaitStatistics|QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics|ResourceUsageStats|Timeouts|AutomaticTuning|WorkflowRuntime|Blocks|Deadlocks|SQLInsights|DatabaseInstances)\"")

processors._change: NO CHANGE - already live exactly as-is. Leave this processor alone.
processors._cost: Zero. The paired COMPLETED event carries the signal; STARTED is a marker only.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"action_name\":\\s*\"BATCH STARTED\"")

processors._rule: R3 — Azure Monitor platform metrics records
processors._basis: Single-regex metrics fingerprint. 'timeGrain' with an ISO-8601 duration (PT1M/PT5M/PT1H) is characteristic of Azure Monitor metric records and is not present on SQL audit events. Collapsed from an earlier two-condition version because the UI allows only one regex per processor and RE2 has no lookahead.
processors._cost: Zero. Platform metrics carry no security evidence. Often a large, overlooked volume contributor (a PT1M metrics stream was observed in this estate's feed list).
processors._failsafe: If no metrics reach this log type the rule simply never fires.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"timeGrain\":\\s*\"PT")

processors._rule: R4 — OPTIONAL: session logout / connection teardown churn
processors._change: DO NOT ADD YET. Confirm the real action_name value in a live event first.
processors._cost: Near-zero, NOT zero. Logons are retained in full - only teardown is dropped. Marginal loss of session-duration context. Omit for a provably zero-cost set.
processors._important: Does NOT drop successful logons. LOGIN SUCCEEDED / DATABASE AUTHENTICATION SUCCEEDED and all FAILED events are retained.

logConditions: body != nil and IsString(body) and IsMatch(body, "\"action_name\":\\s*\"(LOGOUT|DATABASE AUTHENTICATION LOGOUT|CONNECTION CLOSED)\"")
